notes:
Lead source: webinar / content-gen landing page. SMB, B2B SaaS, 20 engineers + product. Primary product: campaign & landing-page copy generation with multi-variant outputs (A/B test permutations).

-- Key pain points / asks:
- Cost sensitivity: wants predictable per-campaign cost; currently pays per-token on other APIs and sees spikes.
- Throughput: need to generate ~500-1,000 variations per campaign batch within <5 minutes (batch window). Latency per token not strict but end-to-end generation time matters.
- Caching & batching interest: asked about prefix caching to reuse common templates and about autoscaling batch concurrency.
- Model preferences: prefer smaller, cheaper models for bulk generation; want easy routing to higher-cap models for hero copy. Interested in multi-model routing & automatic fallback.
- Security: SMB but requires SSO access for internal users and audit logs for client-facing audits. No on-prem requirement; public cloud hosted API is fine.

-- Quotes / paraphrases from call:
- "We need to run tens of thousands of generations per month and the bill is our biggest worry."
- "If we can batch/cached effectively we can cut costs dramatically — show us the numbers."

-- POC ask from customer:
- 7-day hosted API POC using their campaign templates and a 1M tokens/day sample. Want sample batching config and estimated cost under different model choices.

-- Internal notes / AE playbook:
- Provide quickstart template repo (link shared).
- SE to prepare a short script demonstrating prefix caching + batch client. Use dev credits to run sample.
- Prepare cost comparison: small model (quantized) vs mid-tier + fallback routing example.
- Risk: may churn if benchmark doesn't show clear cost savings vs current provider.

-- Next actions assigned:
- SE (Liam): build POC script & run baseline within 48h.
- AE (Sofia): send SSO checklist + drive link to POC pricing doc.

-- Stipulated timeline:
- POC kickoff: target 2026-03-10. Decision expected mid-April (budget cycle).
